spanish: Y dijo Jehová a Moisés: Y si su padre escupiendo escupiere en sus faces, ¿no se avergonzaría siete días? Será cerrada siete días fuera al campamento, y después será reunida.

findings.issue: וְאָבִיהָ is conjunction plus her father. Unmarked si adds a conditional the tokens do not license.
Infinitive absolute plus qal perfect 3ms is emphatic completed spitting he spat. escupiere is future subjunctive and changes that perfect force.
הֲלֹא plus niphal imperfect 3fs is a rhetorical will she not be ashamed. Conditional avergonzaría shifts the imperfect to would.
מִחוּץ is from plus outside and לַ is to the camp. fuera al leaves the separative from unstated and can read as motion toward the camp.
Niphal imperfect 3fs is be gathered. reunida can add reunion or return.

notes: Jehová, Moisés, plural faces, repeated seven days, and the niphal feminine shut clause are licensed.
